source.title: Ever Gonna Fix Horrible Gemdust Drop Rate? — Loolie June 27 firsthand follow-up
source.author: Loolie-210848

quote: I was sitting at like 320-something skill when 365 is required
inputName: Unspecified gold-quality Midnight ore (rank 2); item ID and individual ore species unstated
requires: One player's June 27 gold-rank ore recipe UI showed 365 as its requirement. Equipped profession gear was not correctly counted until removed and re-equipped, after which displayed skill rose to 366 and gold-rank outputs occurred. Applies to this test context only; not independently validated as a global or current-patch cutoff.
notes: First-person before/after: author reported 164 Proficient Processor KP, 30/30 Proficient Processor, 30/30 Prospecting Pro, 30/30 Material Manufacturer, 30/30 Boldly Basic, 40/40 Crushing Connoisseur and 1/1 each Copper/Tin/Silver/Thorium; rare (blue) profession gear. Before re-equipping, effective skill ~320-something and no gold glass through an unquantified large quantity of ores, not a known zero-cast sample. After re-equipping three gear pieces, displayed prospect skill 366 vs recipe 365, author observed gold glass; completed casts, material quantities, hits/zeros/histogram, output ore source, build, refund and bonuses unknown. Identity 242786/rank2 corroborated by https://goldcap.gg/retail/us/items/242786 ; forum gives no output item links. Original earlier Apr 9 360->371 gear-refresh report is a separate author, not merged.
